name: 45440 · Kettering, OH
findings: ZIP 45440 (Kettering) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45440 (Kettering) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 45440 (Kettering) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
